Chapter I

The Day Everything Began

When You Entered My World

May 2024 • Our Roadside Beginning

Our story started on a simple day back in May 2024. That day, I had no idea that the most special person in my whole life was about to walk in.

You came to our house in a car with your mom. My dad, mom, Chuti Akka, and I were standing outside near the road when your car stopped right in front of our gate.

Your mom said you were looking for a campus to study. Without thinking much, I said, “Put her in the same campus I go to,” and told you all about how it was.

Back then, I never imagined that the girl I was helping that day would become the most precious person in my entire world.

Chapter II

Journeys by Your Side

Every Mile With You

Ratnapura to Colombo • Safe in My Care

A few days later, you came over to our house again. I sat with you and helped you fill out your campus application form, explaining everything about classes and campus life.

After that, I went with you and your mom to Colombo to show you the campus and look for boarding. We walked to so many places, and even though we didn't find the right spot and went back home, something sweet had already started between us.

We exchanged phone numbers and began talking every single day. Once campus started, I was always right beside you. I started taking you from Ratnapura to Colombo and bringing you back home safe.

You weren't used to those long travels, so I always stayed close to take care of you. Back then, I just wanted to help you. But day by day, talking to you and caring for you, I started falling deeply in love with you.

Chapter III

Where Forever Began

Our Very First Photograph

Inside the Car • In the Quiet Dark

As time went by, I couldn't keep my feelings hidden anymore.

Around July 7 or 8, 2024, I told you that I loved you.

And on July 14, 2024, your answer came.

2024.07.14

A date neither of us will ever forget. From that day on, our whole world changed. What started as helping each other turned into the most beautiful love story of our lives.

Chapter IV

Our First Solo Date & Nugegoda Coffee

Our Cozy Haven

Nugegoda Barista • Every Last Rupee For Your Smile

One day when you had an interval during your British Council class, we went to One Galle Face together. That was our very first time going out alone together after falling in love. Even today, whenever I remember that day, I get the warmest feeling in my heart.

Later, you started attending dubbing classes in Nugegoda, and that gave us more chances to meet.

Whenever you said you wanted to eat something, I never thought twice—even if it was the last rupee left in my pocket, I spent it gladly on you.

Buying you food, eating together, and seeing you smile was all that mattered to me. To me, that was never an expense. It was just my simple way of showing how much I love you.

Chapter V

Two Hearts That Refused to Give Up

After we fell in love, you asked me to talk to your mom. I went straight to her and said, “Aunty, mama nangita kamathiyi.”

At first there was no big problem, but as days passed, your mom became against us. That wasn't easy for either of us.

We had hard days. There were times we couldn't meet at all. We had to go two or three weeks without seeing each other, and sometimes we waited almost a whole month just to meet.

Through all of it, our love never stopped. We tried our best to be there for each other in every way we could. That's why our story means the world to me.

Our Little World

Safe in Your Embrace

A Quiet Sanctuary

Look at all the places we've been together.

We went to Kotte Rampart Wetland Park. We went to other parks, walked around peaceful temples to pray together, and went for quiet night walks under the stars.

We ate good food at different spots, and sometimes we just walked together without even planning where to go. Every single trip brought us so much happiness.

We never needed fancy places. Just having you next to me was always more than enough.

Chapter VII

Our Journey to Galle

Together in Galle

Pure & Effortless Joy

In 2026, we went on a trip to Galle together.

We walked around, ate, drank, and explored so many places. We fed the sea turtles, went on boat rides, and swung together by the beach with the cool ocean breeze in our hair.

All the photos and videos we took that day are still our favorite memories. What made that day so special wasn't just Galle—it was getting to live every single second of it with you.

Chapter X

To My Dearest Love,

Forever My Favorite View

If someone asks me what our most beautiful memory is, I could never pick just one day. Because every single day I spend with you is a beautiful memory to me.

I don't know how much further our journey will go, or what problems might come in the future. But there is one thing I know for sure:

I love you.

Those words I told you back in July 2024 are still just as true in my heart today.

My love, this is not the end of our story. This is just the most beautiful chapter of our lives, still being written.

I love you, my treasure.
Forever yours,
Sadeepa
